messages:
Alex: Heads-up: we're debating gateway shape for browser SDK -> internal RPCs. two options: 1) gRPC internal + tiny REST front, 2) REST everywhere. which wins for rollout/console UX?
Priya: gRPC internal sounds right to me. typed contracts and streaming make quota/kv caching much easier.
Noor: Agreed on types. but browser SDKs dislike binary. we should keep a tiny JSON front that translates to proto. important: preserve route decision metadata.
Ben: Concrete concerns: 1) per-tenant routing overrides, 2) sticky affinity (session-level route), 3) quota attribution per-model-variant. can gateway support all without leaking complexity to console?
Alex: Plan: gateway owns policy evaluation (tenant overrides, percent rollouts, fallback chains) and emits standardized headers for observability. console reads headers + telemetry to show active policy.
Priya: Header proposal: `X-RW-Route: id=route_42;src=gateway;affinity=session:abcd;reason=overload;v=1`
Noor: Also add `X-RW-Grpc-Status` when we translate backend errors so frontends can show consistent error UI.
Ben: Telemetry: we need per-route latency histograms and token usage. sampling rules: always collect headers for every request, full payload diff 1/200. send to ingestion with route_id & tenant_id.
Alex: UI needs a small panel: "Routing Inspector" showing route_id, reason, percent rollouts, sticky-affinity key, and recent sample trace. link to rollout timeline.
Priya: Rollouts: rollout-service should push events to gateway and console subscribes. events include start_ts, percent, cohorts, previous_policy. we need quick revert button in console (ops-only).
Noor: For cache keys: canonicalize using proto field names and deterministic ordering. gateway should run `proto_canonical_serialize(request)` before using as prefix cache key.
Ben: Example gateway config (JSON):
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"match":"/v1/chat","accept":["application/json"],"to":"grpc://chat-svc","policy":"latency-first","quota_key":"api_key"}
  ]
}
```
Alex: Migration note: existing REST clients will keep working. gateway will support header-based hints to route to pinned model versions for old clients. document in RFC.
Priya: Edge-case: websocket / streaming SDKs. gateway will proxy http2 or upgrade to h2c for streaming to preserve gRPC semantics. need perf tests.
Noor: Observability: console should allow filtering by route_id and show fallback rate over time. alert if fallback_rate > 0.3% for 10m.
Ben: Also add cost-metrics: tokens_charged per route per-tenant so finance can reconcile. backend increments must include route_id and model_variant metadata.
Alex: Security: gateway strips any client-sent route headers. only signed route decisions from gateway allowed. add signature header `X-RW-Route-Sig`.
Priya: Good call. That prevents spoofing. signer key rotates monthly.
Noor: Final ops detail: map gRPC status -> HTTP like: UNAVAILABLE -> 503, INVALID_ARGUMENT -> 400, with `X-RW-Grpc-Status` preserved. console can show both.
Ben: Action items:
- Priya: RFC for gateway shim + migration notes
- Noor: Telemetry schema + sample rate plan
- Alex: Console wireframe for Routing Inspector + revert UX
- Ben: Perf test plan for h2c streaming proxy
Priya: I'll draft RFC today, pinging docs channel when ready.
Alex: Thanks all.
